mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls indicates strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, the S&P 500 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annualized change > 3.0%), a decline in industrial production signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annualized change > 3.0%), INDPRO declines do not lead to negative 60-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0%, it signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% does not lead to negative 5-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales indicates strong consumer demand that boosts corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where both HOUST and RSAFS increase, the S&P 500 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) decline by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals weakening consumer spending that reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines of >0.5% m/m do not lead to negative 20-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (index), it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO levels below 100.0 do not lead to negative 60-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
